summary: The manifest and proposed target match the contract. The generated README gives the recipient an incorrect format-selection rule and omits verification and copy instructions.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-c: scripts/audio-handoff.mjs:70-73 tells recipients that the bus calls canPlayType once, on first unlock. AudioBus probes both formats and can choose during preload, as AC9 states. Document the one-time choice, Ogg preference, and pre-unlock preload so the Monorepo session uses the actual load rule.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Major] review-c: The generated README does not tell recipients how to verify or copy the files. plan.md:761 gives a repo-root checksum command, but the checksum manifest uses bare names. Document verification from inside the bundle, then copying only the 14 sounds to the confirmed target.

F3 [Nit] review-c: scripts/audio-handoff.mjs:17-36 has no usage text or argument check. Passing --help or an unsupported argument takes the normal build path and can replace the existing bundle. Print zero-argument usage and reject unsupported arguments before writing.
